who.value: casual seller starting a new listing

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The title 'List anything yourself' with a 'Drafts' row and a 'Create a listing' card says this is where a listing starts.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Create a listing' is a large card but its label is small regular-weight grey text, so the photo-heavy Drafts row above pulls the eye first.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Create a listing', 'Manage' and the 'Mobile / Doorstep pickup' style tiles each say what they lead to.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Sell to Carousell' is explained right under it by 'Sell directly to us'.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Nothing is asked here beyond choosing to start a listing, resume a draft or sell to Carousell.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only three entry points are shown; drafts are a scrollable row with management behind 'Manage'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Sell to Carousell' tiles (Mobile, Luxury, Fashion, Cars) are a different path from the screen's titled job 'List anything yourself' and take half the first screen.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and short tile subtitles carry the screen; there is no paragraph to read.
